scope.summary: Implement the NORMATIVE format promotion gate: a format import/export feature MUST NOT be promoted (parity-complete/shippable) unless it declares ALL five artifacts — (a) compatibility scope (what is preserved/transformed/rasterized/unsupported), (b) fixtures per supported app-and-direction, (c) round-trip expectations (bounded fidelity envelope), (d) unsupported-feature diagnostics/receipts (machine-readable, emitted at decode/encode, surfaced to operator+model), (e) recovery behavior (deterministic non-destructive handling of malformed/partial/truncated/password-protected/version-newer inputs; fail closed, never silent partial write). A format missing any is `unsupported` or `optional adapter`, not promoted. Implement the preservation-blob law: vendor-private structures Studio cannot model are carried as an opaque preservation blob, re-emitted on same-family export, receipt-separated from semantically imported structure, and stored as authority data under the no-SQLite rule.
acceptance_criteria: five-artifact gate enforced fail-closed; preservation blob carried/re-emitted/receipted; no SQLite
proof_targets: five-artifact gate fail-closed + preservation-blob round-trip test
expected_tests: negative: format missing any of the 5 artifacts cannot be promoted (fails closed)
test: preservation blob carried + re-emitted on same-family export; receipt separates opaque vs semantic; no SQLite storage

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Formats promoted without fixtures/receipts; silent structure loss on round-trip.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
